contract: An unknown component type / extension field in the canonical input MUST be preserved verbatim (never silently dropped or emptied). The adapter records it as a deviation and emits a warning; it does NOT pass catalog conformance silently. The drift harness (1-7-4-4) then decides: version drift = report only; semantic loss (field deletion / unknown dropped) = hard fail.
capture_method: declarative-contract; the preservation rule is validated at the adapter boundary (1-7-2) and exercised by the drift harness. The unknown field is carried through the flat Spec as an element whose `type` is absent from the pinned catalog, surfaced by catalog conformance (FF-JR-PROJ-01 validation block) rather than discarded.
